functionalInvariants.trigger: Switch to Markdown 源码 or rich-editor fallback
permissionRules: Active edit-capability token and supported Markdown required; write uses anonymous CSRF, same Origin and expectedModifiedAt. Existing draft text remains available on failure; referenced whiteboards are read-only.

PublicShareEditor initializes kind=document directly. NoteEditorHost calls parseSource with source-codec eligibility enabled=true; do not infer that public rich editing is disabled by the owner VITE_DOCUMENT_EDITOR_ENABLED setting.
The active public token and source/save restrictions remain authoritative in both modes, including after a rich-eligibility fallback; an empty body is not a validation failure.

fields.name: draft
fields.constraints: same capability source/CAS/resource restrictions as document mode; blank draft is allowed. The save JSON payload must contain a string content property, including an empty string; payload-property presence is separate from UI/nonempty validation. Save eligibility is dirty-state and busy/loading/composing/blocked/expiry based, not nonempty based.

importantStates: plain source editing with same manual save status
Blank body is valid; a dirty deletion to empty can be saved when the ordinary save guards permit it. An unchanged blank baseline is clean, not invalid.

Ctrl/Cmd+F or Ctrl/Cmd+H inside either mode opens the shared current-note find/replace panel; zero results disables next/previous and replacement actions. Escape closes it; case-sensitive matching, current replacement and replace-all remain local draft operations.
Find remains available while host readOnly is true; replacement input/actions are disabled while readOnly (busy/reloading), and replacement is guarded during composition.

Source mode can be explicitly chosen for otherwise rich-eligible content or reached automatically by the size/unit/depth/reference-syntax fallback; warning explains why source mode preserves the original.
Attempting document mode again reruns parseSource eligibility; ineligible content falls back again without granting broader source/resource permissions.
notes: Shared find/replace layout and detailed controls cross-reference coverage/workspace.json WS-045; public reachability is through NoteEditorHost keyboard handling, not an owner toolbar button.

PublicShareEditor exposes document/source mode, save and return-reading controls. It does not mount the owner full editor toolbar or handle NoteEditorHost insert-menu events, so do not add an owner insert menu to the public mockup.

prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate exactly ONE high-fidelity, legible Simplified Chinese DooKnow desktop UI design, approximately 1536×1024, no browser/device frame, no presentation captions. Image 1 is the matching REAL pre-redesign baseline: its content, visible actions, user role and selected state are authoritative. Image 2 PILOT-WS-001 is STYLE ONLY: use its restrained blue #4566c6, white #ffffff, light-gray #f7f8fa, text #272b3a, muted #657084, fine #e6e9f1 dividers, 8px radii, clear typographic density and aligned flat surfaces. Do not transfer its owner rail, notebook tree, empty-note state, or unrelated actions.
ROLE BOUNDARY: this is a standalone authorization/public share page. NO owner avatar/rail/sidebar/private note tree/settings/apps/recent/favorites/trash navigation. NO blog navigation unless explicitly present. Preserve only this baseline's role-specific brand/header/footer and content. No ToDoo brand/task/calendar content, teams/members, AI chat, social login, password gate, upload/publish controls, fabricated counts/success/connected state. No API/contract/developer metadata or requestId/version/hash/cursor/nonce/CSRF fields in UI. One coherent state only, no simultaneous overlays or all-state dashboard. Preserve conditional controls and real enabled/disabled guards. Treat exact source templates as authority and make existing primary actions reachable; do not shrink legibility.
